messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a latency/regression after the variant-routing tweak that shipped at 12:10. 95th/99th jumped, and batch formation collapsed.

riley: saw the alert too, digging into pool-6 traces. early signs point to compat-set fragmentation: requests routed to mixed variants, so the batcher can’t merge them. avg batch size = 1.6.

sanjay: confirmed in profiler. kernel selection overhead is higher when we fallback between quantized and fp16 variants mid-batch. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~18% for warm sessions.

marta: perf-bot posted a few metrics:
```
SCHEDULE_LOG pool=6 time=12:11:03 queued=84 formed=18 avg_batch=1.6 token_budget_target=32 tokens_sent=142
KVCACHE hit_rate=0.72 warm_hit=0.58
KERNEL_SWITCH events=23 avg_switch_ms=4.7
```

kevin: the token_budget_target=32 seems too low for mixed-variant workloads. small token budget forces early flushes and more frequent kernel switches.

alex: agree. also noticed queue policy was set to `strict-variant-sticky` after the rollout. that prevents permissive merging of compatible model variants.

riley: quick experiment on staging: switched queue policy to `compat-merge-prefer` and bumped token_budget_target to 128. result: avg_batch -> 6.1, kernel switches dropped 70%, kv warm_hit up to 0.83.

sanjay: posted the staging command and diff: 
```bash
# staging tweak
redwoodctl set-pool-policy pool-6 --queue-policy=compat-merge-prefer --token-budget=128
redwoodctl profile run --pool=6 --duration=300 --tags=variant-frag-test
```

marta: important to be careful — `compat-merge-prefer` can increase tail latency for strictly low-latency customers if a large compatible batch forms. we should add a per-customer latency SLO override.

kevin: proposed rollout plan: 1) canary 5% traffic pool-6 for 1h with new policy, 2) collect kernel-switch, kv-hit, avg_batch, p95/p99, 3) revert if p99 > baseline + 10%.

alex: add automated checks: ops-bot, can you create a regression alert for kernel-switch rate and kv-warm-hit drop? link it to the canary job.

ops-bot: created alert `kernel-switch-rate-up` (severity=warning) and `kv-warm-hit-drop` (severity=critical). triggered on 2x kernel-switch or 10% absolute drop in kv warm hits.

riley: one more note — kernel selection: add `--prefer-stable-kernel` flag in runtime to avoid hot re-jitting for small batches. that lowered avg_switch_ms in staging from 4.7 -> 1.5ms.

sanjay: also captured a short profile dump (`/tmp/frag-profile-173777`) with call stacks and a small flame graph. I'll attach to the PR.

marta: PR checklist: update console dashboard to expose `compat_merge_rate`, add per-route SLO override, add canary gating in the rollout pipeline, and a short doc blurb describing tradeoffs.

alex: thanks. action items:
- sanjay: attach profile + flamegraphs to PR and iterate kernel flag. (ETA 2h)
- riley: run canary and capture metrics (ETA 1h)
- kevin: draft canary rollback playbook and SLO override text (ETA 30m)
- marta: update dashboard panels (ETA EOD)

kevin: will also schedule a quick follow-up sync in 45m to make a go/no-go.

alex: keeping this thread as the single source for the incident notes. drop short updates here. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: perf snapshot saved -> /artifacts/perf/173777-frag-snap.json, baseline comparison queued.

riley: started canary now (5% -> pool-6) — posting initial numbers in 10m.

alex: perfect — thanks team.
